payload.title: Pin every metrics command and refresh the requirements map comments
payload.body:
A fresh grade of main after #35 found six docs/metrics.md rows that say "same" instead of a runnable command, and requirements.yaml comments that predate the updated new-project rules (allow-listed event fields, logs off in tests, pinned queries, (stub) for sources that answer 0, hooks step warns).
- **Hypothesis**: rows with an exact runnable command rise from 6/16 to 16/16, and every map comment names the current rule.
- **Measurement**: grep -c "| same" docs/metrics.md (expect 0) and an independent grade of rules 4 and 10
- **Success**: 0 "same" rows; grader PASS on rules 4 and 10.
- **Pivot**: if a command cannot be one line, link a named function in scripts/metrics.sh instead.
- **Anchor**: agentbrew new-project SKILL.md (metrics row); tasks.md PR #35 grade.
